B is slightly cheaper than D and has a solid Monday time, but its 4:55 p.m. Friday departure may be too early for some normal workdays. D better fits a conventional after-work departure and midday return, but costs more than B. C has the latest convenient Friday/Monday schedule and a more flexible fare type, but costs more and airport/fare-flexibility value is unspecified. Choosing among these tradeoffs requires unstated preferences about work departure flexibility, price, airport convenience, and fare benefits.
